blocks.text: Organic reactions teen bunyadi baaton se aasani se samajh aate hain: covalent bond do tareeqon se toot sakta hai (homolytic aur heterolytic); reagents teen qism ke hain (free radicals, electrophiles aur nucleophiles); aur reactions chand aam qismon mein aate hain.

items: Homolytic fission (homolysis) tab hota hai jab non-polar bond toote: do mushtarka electrons barabar bat'te hain, har atom ko aik, maslan Cl-Cl -> Cl. + .Cl aur H3C-H -> .CH3 + H. (nuqta unpaired electron hai). Unpaired electrons wale atoms ya groups free radicals hain; yeh reactive darmiyani species hain kyunke unpaired electron jora banana chahta hai.

blocks.alt: Homolysis ki do masawatein. Cl-Cl se nuqte wala Cl aur nuqte wala Cl; H3C-H se nuqte wala CH3 aur nuqte wala H. Har aik mein bond ke beech se do aadhe sire wale (single-barbed) mure teer nikalte hain, aik aik atom ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Cl-Cl aur H3C-H ka homolytic fission (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aadhe sire wala mura teer (fish-hook) sirf aik electron ki harkat dikhata hai. Non-polar bond ke do electrons barabar bat'te hain: har atom ek electron le jata hai. Is liye har hissa aik unpaired electron (nuqta) ke saath free radical ban jata hai: Cl. aur Cl., ya .CH3 aur H.

items: Heterolytic fission (heterolysis) tab hota hai jab polar bond toote: aik atom dono electrons rakh kar manfi ho jata, jab ke doosre ke paas aik electron kam reh jata aur woh musbat ho jata hai.
Carbocation aisi species hai jis mein carbon atom par musbat charge ho. Yeh tab banti hai jab carbon O, N, S ya Cl jaise zyada electronegative atom se jura ho, maslan (CH3)3C-Cl -> (CH3)3C+ + Cl-.

blocks.alt: (CH3)3C-Cl, beech wale carbon par teen CH3; carbon par +delta aur Cl par -delta, aur aik mura teer C-Cl bond se Cl ki taraf. Is se (CH3)3C+ (beech wale carbon par + charge) aur Cl- bante hain.
blocks.caption: (CH3)3C-Cl se carbocation ka banna (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Poore sire wala mura teer electron ka jora (pair) hilata hai. Cl carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye C-Cl bond polar hai: C par +delta aur Cl par -delta. Heterolysis mein bond ka jora poora Cl le leta hai aur Cl- ban jata hai; carbon ka aik electron kam ho jata hai aur woh musbat (carbocation) ban jata hai.

items: Carbanion, jis mein carbon par manfi charge ho, tab banta hai jab carbon Li, Mg ya Cd jaise kam electronegative dhaat ke atom se jura ho.

blocks.text: Reaction ko aik species ka doosri par hamla samjha ja sakta hai: hamla karne wali species reagent aur jis par hamla ho woh substrate hai.

blocks.caption: Reagents ki qismein
rows: unpaired electron wala atom ya group
naya bond banane ke liye electron jora leta hai; musbat ion (carbocations samet) ya neutral molecule
CH3+, H+, Br+, NO2+, SO3, BF3
naya bond banane ke liye electron jora deta hai; manfi ion (carbanions samet) ya lone pair wala neutral molecule
CH3-, Br-, OH-, CN-, NH3, H2O, ROH

blocks.text: Electrophilic aur nucleophilic jagahein sirf ions tak mehdood nahi: polar molecule mein juzwi charges unhein banate hain. CH3-OH mein carbon delta+ (electrophilic) aur oxygen delta- (nucleophilic) hai; CH3-Li mein carbon delta- (nucleophilic) aur lithium delta+ hai.

blocks.caption: Kitab ki misalon ke saath organic reactions ki qismein
rows: aik molecule ka atom ya group doosre se badal jata; do products ban sakte
CH2=CH2 + H2 -> CH3-CH3 (Ni, 200-300 C); CH3CH=CH2 + HBr -> CH3CHBrCH3
do parosi atoms se atoms ya groups hat kar multiple bond banta; addition ka ulat
CH3CH2Br + KOH (alcohol mein) -> CH2=CH2 + KBr + H2O
paani se reaction kar ke compound toot'ta, aksar H+ ya OH- ki madad se
do molecules jur kar bara molecule, H2O, NH3 ya HCl jaisa chhota molecule nikle ya na nikle
electrons ka nuqsan, oxygen ka izafa, hydrogen ka nuqsan, zyada C-O bonds ya carbon ka ooncha oxidation state
CH3CH=CH2 pehle O3 phir Zn/H2O -> CH3CHO + HCHO
electrons ka izafa, oxygen ka nuqsan, hydrogen ka izafa, kam C-O bonds ya carbon ka kam oxidation state

blocks.title: Kaun sa bromopropane?
blocks.text: Kitab propene aur HBr ka product CH3-CH2-CH2-Br likhti hai. Asal product 2-bromopropane, CH3CHBrCH3, hai (H CH2 wale sire par lagta hai, Markovnikov's rule), jaisa kitab ka apna Quick Check 19.6 dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis substitution, addition ya paani se tootna hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis: paani ester ko ethanoic acid aur ethanol mein tor deta hai, H+ ki madad se.

items: Homolysis se free radicals; heterolysis se ions (carbocations, carbanions).
Electrophiles electron jora lete, nucleophiles dete.
Reactions ki qismein: substitution, addition, elimination, hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation, reduction.
